technique_name: Describe the characters of Dickens' book Great Expectations in 3 sentences
description: The characters of Great Expectations are mainly Pip, Joe Gargery, Miss Havisham, Estella, Abel Magwitch, and Herbert Pocket. Each of these characters has distinct personalities and experiences life-changing events from which they learn lessons. Pip, for example, starts as an innocent, lonely orphan and learns the important truth that establishing deep meaningful relationships is essential for personal growth.
